newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Aug 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Aug 5.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on Aug. 5:

WASHINGTON - A group of Internet users who are angry about the mass posting of advertisements on electronic bulletin boards have blocked or destroyed thousands of postings made by customers of UUNet Technologies Inc. of Fairfax, Virginia.

WASHINGTON - The latest round of negotiations over China's entry into the World Trade Organization has ended with Beijing remaining "essentially nonresponsive" in many areas of concern to the United States, U.S. Trade Representative Charlene Barshefsky said.

WASHINGTON - The Teamsters strike against United Parcel Service comes as federal investigators are expanding their probe into allegations of illegal financing of union President Ron Carey's reelection campaign last year.
WASHINGTON - Customers were looking for alternatives to ship their goods in the wake of the Teamsters union strike against United Parcel Service.
